MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING

This Memorandum of Understanding is made on 14 March 2026

BETWEEN
RHC City Pty Ltd ACN 612 345 678 of Brisbane, Queensland ("Developer")
AND
Harbourline Capital Holdings Pty Ltd ACN 987 654 321 ("Investor")

1. Purpose
The parties wish to record their understanding regarding a joint development of the property at Lot 12 on SP 123456, Fortitude Valley (the Site).

2. Investment
2.1 The Investor will invest $4,500,000 in the project, subject to due diligence and Investor board approval.
2.2 The Developer must pay a non-refundable deposit of $250,000 to the Investor within 10 business days of signing this MOU.
2.3 Interest on any overdue amount accrues at 18% per annum.

3. Exclusivity
The Developer must not negotiate with any other party in relation to the Site.

4. Indemnity
The Developer shall indemnify the Investor against any and all losses, claims, costs and liabilities arising in connection with the Site.

5. Termination
The Investor may terminate this MOU at any time for any reason by giving 7 days notice.

6. Variation
The Investor may vary the terms of this MOU by notice to the Developer.

7. Governing law
This MOU is governed by the laws of New South Wales.

8. Fees
The fee payable to the Developer is [insert] and the timetable is to be agreed.

Signed for and on behalf of RHC City Pty Ltd
